items.title: DD-R: the relative endgame — Z(♦), local generators via lm:ctn/Nakayama, certificate inherited from the ambient summand, inverse laws, divRep
DD-R seed fibre models: relation-image models at stages zero and one
DD-Q: the divQProj quasi-projectivity bundle + consumer export lemmas + the DAT-D blueprint nodes
DAT-C: the $\Sigma$-charts — the $h^1$-vanishing open of $\mathrm{Div}^g$-lite, canonical-section normalization ($h^0 = 1$), mono chart functors, open fibre products
DAT-B: coverage + injectivity — every $\mathrm{pic}^0$ point is Zariski-locally a chart point (RE-5 descent + engine + DAT-P points); injectivity from the separatedness lane
DD-R datum tail: universal family and DAT-D/DAT-G assembly
DD-R divRep: affine classification, Zariski/global representability, and consumer export
DD-R certificate: inherited certificate, epsilon projection, U1/U2, and inverse laws
DD-R RD-N: ideal purity and local principal generation via flatness and Nakayama
DD-R fallback: universal flattening strata or the affine Hilbert algebra chart
DD-R quotient bridge: genuine chart quotient as the shifted colimit with base-change flatness
DD-R relative bridge induction: all-stage fibre models and successor quotient flatness
DD-R saturation: coefficient action, ideal-span assembly, and eventual read-kernel killing
DD-R fibre exactness: all-window field Koszul equality and normalized multiplication conjugacy
DD-R relation tower: recursive relations, stage anchors, transitions, and cofinal chart exhaustion
DD-R foundation: high-window ambients, H1 vanishing, persistence, and theta transport
